messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the trace-hook rollup + sampling policy for the Console observability roadmap. Customers want cost vs fidelity knobs and a clear launch checklist.

sam: Agree. Two levers we can ship: rollup interval (raw -> 1s/5s/60s aggregates) and sampling strategy (head-based, tail-based, error-only).

mike: From SRE pov, error-only + head-sampling for latency-sensitive paths looks safest. We need per-route sampling rates surfaced in the UI so customers can see cost impact.

anya: UX asks: surface expected token/cost delta for each policy change, and a quick preview of how traces will look after rollup. Also: exportable sampling policy JSON.

elaine: Good. Can we prototype a minimal config format that meets those asks? Something small like:
```json
{"rollup_interval": "5s", "sampling": {"default": 0.05, "errors": 1.0, "head_seconds": 2}}
```
This would be the default shown in the Console.

sam: That config works. Implementation notes: rollup_interval ties into ingestion pipeline; 5s adds ~10% CPU on the collector at our QPS baseline. 60s reduces cost but loses short-lived spans.

mike: We should define launch SLOs: sample retention correctness >99.5 for error traces, UI preview latency <300ms, and cost delta estimate within +/-15% of actual.

anya: For acceptance tests, propose: (1) customer policy applied -> we ingest a traced request matrix and verify sampling rates match target, (2) UI shows cost estimate that matches billing test job.

elaine: Prioritization: MVP must include per-route sampling toggle + global rollup slider + cost estimate. Nice-to-have: per-tenant presets and automatic suggestions based on traffic profile.

sam: One risk: model-based suggestions (Optimize) might recommend aggressive sampling that misses rare regression signals. We need a fallback 'observe errors fully' safety switch.

mike: Ops runbook note: when toggling sampling, include a quick rollback button that flips to 100% for last 24h on-demand to repro customer bugs.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: telemetry-rollup-service v2 scheduled to staging 2098770000. Ensure feature-flag gated.

elaine: Action items: Sam -> perf impact spec and collector config changes by EOD Tue. Mike -> SLO + runbook draft. Anya -> mockups for cost estimate widget and exportable policy by Thu. I'll collate acceptance criteria and update the roadmap ticket. :+1:
